title: Create Aesthetic C01-C04 Performance Assessment Answer Schemes with Bilingual Competency Rubrics
description: Develop comprehensive marking schemes and bilingual competency rubrics for all Aesthetic Services performance assessments (C01-C04), ensuring consistent evaluation across practical demonstrations with clear evidence requirements aligned to NOSS CoCU.
acceptanceCriteria: Create/update aesthetic-services/c01/PA.md through c04/PA.md with bilingual competency rubrics (EN/BM) for each work activity with 4-5 competency levels (Novice, Competent, Proficient, Expert) and observable evidence descriptors
Each PA includes answer schemes linking assessment items to NOSS CoCU Work Activities (WA-01, WA-02, etc.) with specific competency criteria and marking guidance
Validate all bilingual terms against _reference/aesthetic-bilingual-glossary.md for terminology consistency across all documents
technicalNotes: File to edit: aesthetic-services/c01/PA.md through c04/PA.md (add: rubric table with EN/BM headers, evidence checklist, competency progression matrix)
Reference validation: grep -r against _reference/aesthetic-bilingual-glossary.md to ensure term consistency
Test command: grep -c 'Work Activity' aesthetic-services/*/PA.md (verify all WA mappings present)

title: Implement IT Level 4 Knowledge Assessment with Advanced Systems Management Competency Rubrics
description: Create comprehensive knowledge assessments (KA) for IT Level 4 (Computer System Management - Advanced) with scenario-based questions targeting systems administration, network management, and IT service management competencies, including integrated answer schemes with expert-level rubrics.
acceptanceCriteria: Create it-computer-system/level-4/KA.md with 40-50 questions in mixed formats: MCQ (15), short answer (15), scenario-based (10), diagram labeling (5-10), with each question mapped to specific Level 4 NOSS CoCU Learning Outcomes
Include integrated answer schemes with competency rubrics showing marking guidance, pass thresholds, and evidence requirements for each question type aligned to Level 4 standards
Develop minimum 8 scenario-based diagnostic questions with decision trees showing correct IT troubleshooting pathways and competency evidence mapping for systems administration scenarios
technicalNotes: File to create: it-computer-system/level-4/KA.md following WIM structure template from it-computer-system/level-3/KA.md
Source reference: _reference/it-level-4-noss-extract.md (extract NOSS CoCU Level 4 data if missing)
Test command: grep -E '^##' it-computer-system/level-4/KA.md | wc -l (validate section structure compliance)

title: Create IT Level 3 Performance Assessment with Systems Administration Competency Rubrics
description: Develop performance assessment (PA) for IT Level 3 with practical competency rubrics for systems administration tasks, complementing the existing Level 3 KA, ensuring complete assessment coverage with observable evidence criteria and bilingual competency descriptors.
acceptanceCriteria: Create it-computer-system/level-3/PA.md with competency rubrics for 6-8 key systems administration work activities (user account management, system backup/recovery, security configuration, performance monitoring, etc.) with 4-level rubrics (Novice to Expert)
Each work activity includes observable evidence requirements, marking checklist, and bilingual competency descriptors (EN/BM) aligned to Level 3 NOSS CoCU
PA document includes assessor guidance, safety checklists, and competency progression criteria with worked examples for borderline cases
technicalNotes: File to create: it-computer-system/level-3/PA.md (complement to existing it-computer-system/level-3/KA.md)
Bilingual validation: cross-reference _reference/it-bilingual-glossary.md for systems administration terminology consistency
Test command: grep -E '(Evidence|Rubric|Criteria)' it-computer-system/level-3/PA.md | wc -l (verify evidence framework coverage)
